Rules for your first real job
as a man

1. Finish before you're asked

Deadlines are the minimum.

2. Have lunch with different people

Not just your team.

3. Learn beyond your job title

The curious ones get promoted.

4. Never send an email angry

Wait until tomorrow.

5. Dress one level up

For the job you want next.
